item.title: Some Things Just Take Time
item.description: Armin Ronacher on software development in the AI era: why a 50-year-old oak tree cannot be mass-produced, and why the things that truly matter all need time.

item.title: Rust + AI Are Quietly Killing Python's Biggest Advantage (And Most Devs Haven't Noticed)
item.description: Python didn't dominate AI because it's fast, but because it tolerates human uncertainty. But when AI starts writing code, that advantage is slowly disappearing.
